d: NASA Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO) Tier-A solar analogue targets for direct imaging of Earth-like exoplanets.

gaia-2452378776434477184.x: Single G-dwarf at 11.9 light-years; top-tier HWO target for direct coronagraphic imaging of habitable-zone terrestrial planets.

gaia-5164707970261890560.x: Nearby young K-dwarf at 10.5 light-years harboring known giant planet and dual debris disks for disk-planet interaction study.

gaia-6427464123776727168.x: Old, quiet solar twin at 19.9 light-years considered one of the highest-priority targets for terrestrial planet direct imaging.

gaia-4847957293278177024.x: Bright solar analogue at 19.7 light-years hosting confirmed super-Earths and a prominent circumstellar dust disk.

gaia-3195919528989223040.x: Primary star of the 40 Eridani triple system at 16.3 light-years, prime nearby target for habitable exoplanet searches.

b.s: High-priority solar twin and solar analogue stars shortlisted for NASA Habitable Worlds Observatory direct coronagraphic imaging.
